# Schulich ROAM

> ROAM (Robotics Operation for Autonomous Mapping) is a student robotics club at the Schulich School of Engineering, University of Calgary (Calgary, Alberta, Canada). The club is building ATLAS-1, an autonomous rover for LiDAR mapping and 3D digital-twin generation.

Not to be confused with Roam Research, Roam Robotics, or other companies named Roam.

- Website: https://schulichroam.com
- Disciplines: mechanical, electrical, software, geomatics, business operations, content and media
- Tech focus: ROS 2, dual LiDAR, stereo cameras, RTK-GNSS, sensor fusion, LiDAR SLAM, point cloud processing
- Contact: contact@schulichroam.com (general), team@schulichroam.com (recruitment), sponsorship@schulichroam.com (sponsorship)
